patthana18.17:1.1: āsavasampayuttaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na āsavasampayutto na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana18.17:2.1: āsavavippayuttaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na āsavavippayutto na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana18.17:3.1: āsavasampayuttaṃ hetuñca āsavavippayuttaṃ hetuñca dhammaṃ paṭicca na āsavasampayutto na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi. hetuyā nava.
patthana18.17:4.1: āsavasampayuttaṃ nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na āsavasampayutto na nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana18.17:5.1: āsavavippayuttaṃ nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na āsavasampayutto na nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: ekaṃ. hetuyā cattāri. āsavasāsavaduka hetuduke naāsavasāsavaduka nahetudukaṃ
